grammarFocus: we / they；are；规则复数；my / your / his / her；have / has。
title: My Family and Our Things
instructions: 阅读短文，然后回答问题。所有题目都是单选题或填空题。填空题的答案必须来自原文，且不超过规定的字数。本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。
passage:
A. My name is Li Wei. I am a student. This is my family. We are four people: my father, my mother, my sister, and me. We are happy.

B. My father is a teacher. He has a bike. My mother is a nurse. She has a car. My sister is a student. She has two books. I have three pens. We have many things.

C. My sister and I are students. We have a dog. The dog is small. We like our dog. My father and mother are busy. They are at work. We are at school. We are a happy family.

questions.explanation: 原文说“We are four people”，意思是“我们是四口人”。
questions.evidence: We are four people: my father, my mother, my sister, and me.

questions.explanation: 原文说“He has a bike.”，意思是“他有一辆自行车”。
原文说“She has a car.”，意思是“她有一辆汽车”。
原文说“She has two books.”，意思是“她有两本书”。
原文说“I have three pens.”，意思是“我有三支笔”。

questions.prompt: 李伟的妹妹和他是学生。他们有一只什么动物？请用英文填写。
questions.explanation: 原文说“We have a dog.”，意思是“我们有一只狗”。所以动物是狗。

questions.prompt: 李伟的爸爸和妈妈在哪里？
questions.explanation: 原文说“They are at work.”，意思是“他们在工作”。

questions.prompt: 李伟和他的妹妹在哪里？
questions.explanation: 原文说“We are at school.”，意思是“我们在学校”。

grammar.title: 一般现在时：have/has 与 are 的用法
grammar.explanation: 在英语中，表示“有”时，I/you/we/they 用 have，he/she/it 用 has。表示“是”时，we/they 用 are。例如：I have a pen. She has a book. We are students. They are at work.
grammar.example: We have a dog. She has a car. They are at work.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：I ___ a pen.
questions.explanation: 主语是 I，表示“有”用 have。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：She ___ a book.
questions.explanation: 主语是 She，表示“有”用 has。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：We ___ students.
questions.explanation: 主语是 We，表示“是”用 are。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：They ___ at work.
questions.explanation: 主语是 They，表示“是”用 are。

part1: How many people are in your family?
speaking.part2: Describe your family. You should say: who is in your family, what they have, where they are, and how you feel about your family.
part3: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
What do you have in your bag?
Are you a student or a teacher?
Is your family big or small?

transfer.writing: 写一段话介绍你的家庭。用上 have/has 和 are。至少写5句话。
